title: Mapping Market Structure Evolution
authors: Maximilian Matthe; Daniel M. Ringel; Bernd Skiera
eligible_reason: Methods paper proposing EvoMap (dynamic mapping of market structure). The package contains simulation code, EvoMDS/EvoSammon/EvoTSNE/dynamic t-SNE implementations, evaluation criteria and the TNIC firm-similarity data for the application. No regression or DiD code; the full-text hit for 'difference-in-differences' is not supported by any estimation in the package.
design_notes: Python 3.7: src/simulation (data_generator, simulate_scenarios, estimation, evaluate_positions), src/models (evomap, dtsne), src/evaluation. data/tnic_data (Hoberg-Phillips TNIC-2 pairwise similarities), names.csv.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not a DiD paper.
